description: Lollipop Chart by CBT Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All Features Lollipop Chart presents a single value for each category as a marker on a slender stem anchored to the baseline, sharing one value axis — a clean, low-clutter alternative to the bar chart for ranked comparison across many categories. With an optional per-category target, the same view becomes a performance-versus-goal analysis: markers are coloured by variance band and labelled with the gap to target. Currency and percentage formats are read from the data model, and full Power BI interactivity is built in. Key Capabilities Dual Orientation — Switch between horizontal bar and vertical column layouts from a single toggle. Target & Variance Banding — Add a per-category target and colour each marker over, on, or under goal. Three-Measure Encoding — Drive marker size and colour from their own measures to show up to three metrics at once. Four Marker Shapes — Circle, square, diamond, or triangle with independent size, colour, opacity, and outline. Data Labels & Indicators — Value, Target, and Change labels with absolute or percentage display and up/down triangles. Native Interactivity — Cross-filtering, drill-down, drill-through, report-page tooltips, and context menus, plus conditional colour and reference lines and bands.
